lessonGrammar.name: 不定式作目的状语
lessonGrammar.note: to compare our version of the same text 说明每周见面的目的。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: In our translation group, we meet every Thursday to compare our version of the same text, and each member may explain the choice behind every phrase.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 在我们的翻译小组里,我们每周四碰面,比较我们对同一文本的不同译本,而每个成员都可以解释每个短语背后的取舍。

lessonGrammar.name: 介词短语作定语
lessonGrammar.note: behind every phrase 修饰 choice,相当于 the choice that lies behind every phrase。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: In our translation group, we meet every Thursday to compare our version of the same text, and each member may explain the choice behind every phrase.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 在我们的翻译小组里,我们每周四碰面,比较我们对同一文本的不同译本,而每个成员都可以解释每个短语背后的取舍。

lessonGrammar.name: 非限制性定语从句 who
lessonGrammar.note: who 引导非限制性定语从句,补充说明 partner 的性格。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: My partner, who is an amiable and patient reader, may point out that a word-for-word translation may sound stiff in Chinese, and the spirit of the sentence may matter more than its form.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 我的搭档是一位和蔼而耐心的读者,他也许会指出:逐字翻译在中文里可能显得生硬,句子的神韵比其形式更重要。

lessonGrammar.name: that 宾语从句(并列)
lessonGrammar.note: 两个 that 引导的宾语从句由 and 连接,共同作 point out 的宾语。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: My partner, who is an amiable and patient reader, may point out that a word-for-word translation may sound stiff in Chinese, and the spirit of the sentence may matter more than its form.

lessonGrammar.name: 英译汉技巧
lessonGrammar.note: word-for-word 逐字死译易生硬,应追求 spirit 与 form 的统一,是本单元翻译技巧的核心话题。
